name: mirage
text: Sorry for the wait. Engine: yes, it's running fine. Heartbeat is fresh, the last scan took 44 s and found 128 +EV lines (ParlayAPI, PropLine and SGO answering, plus the exchange feeds). It placed nothing in the last pass only because the 5 listed bets were held back by the 6 h trap guard or thin fair. PropLine Streaming Lite (9): it adds a websocket that pushes line moves and drops/adds as they happen, with a daily quota ~10x Pro's (250k vs 25k), and pushes don't count against quota. The upgrade is freshness, not scan speed. Today PropLine's prices are 2-4 min old when read; pushed they'd be seconds old, which is the thing that makes fair prices go stale and bets vanish. The scan itself (44 s) is mostly Novig reading and the fair-odds pass, which a stream wouldn't shorten much. Catch: it needs a filter (sport/book list) and 2 connections, and I haven't built the stream reader yet. If you subscribe I'll build it on the engine. Worth it if you bet props/PropLine-priced lines a lot; otherwise a modest gain.
